# Direct Python dependencies for the BrowserAgent/verl training environment.
# PyTorch is installed first from the cu128 index by install_browseragent_v2.sh.
# Keep numpy below 2 because verl 0.7.0.dev0 declares numpy<2.0.0.
numpy==1.26.4
vllm==0.11.0
# vLLM 0.11 requires Transformers >=4.55.2. Pin the known-good pair and
# verify its eager tokenizer import so incomplete module/metadata installs do
# not survive the environment smoke test.
transformers==4.57.6
tokenizers==0.22.2
# TensorBoard 2.21 generates protobuf code with 6.31.1, while AceCoder's
# evalplus/google-generativeai chain still requires protobuf<6. Keep the
# compatible pair already validated by the reference BrowserAgent environment.
tensorboard==2.20.0
protobuf==5.29.6
# Some pre-existing installs contain ipywidgets without its small comm runtime.
comm==0.2.3
flash-attn==2.8.1
megatron-core==0.16.1
transformer-engine[pytorch]==2.6.0.post1

# Browser, tool-server, and repository runtime dependencies.
